LanguageData.ABY_ProtocolResearch_OpenNexusDesc: Open the experimental Abyssal Protocol Matrix. This system is isolated from the current forge and summoning progression and can be removed cleanly if it does not survive testing.
LanguageData.ABY_ProtocolResearch_InspectOnline: Protocol Nexus: powered and decoding hostile signal layers.
LanguageData.ABY_ProtocolResearch_InspectOffline: Protocol Nexus: offline. The matrix can still be inspected, but the active decoding overlay is dormant.
LanguageData.ABY_ProtocolResearch_InspectExperimental: Experimental feature island: no current unlocks are hard-gated by this building.
LanguageData.ABY_ProtocolResearch_Subtitle: Experimental protocol matrix: contact, stabilization, integration, dominion and post-gate research layers.
LanguageData.ABY_ProtocolResearch_NoExplicitRequireme: No explicit requirements beyond the selected protocol layer.
LanguageData.ABY_ProtocolResearch_IsolatedWarning: This prototype is intentionally isolated. It displays planned and represented research logic, but it does not currently rewrite forge unlocks, summoning gates, recipes, boss flags or save-game progression.
